title: RIPDPI bundle `ripdpi` object schema
description: Executable contract for the top-level `ripdpi` object that emit-bundle.sh appends to the sing-box document and the RIPDPI Android client parses (SingBoxSubscriptionParser). This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: it is vendored byte-identical into the client repo at core/data/src/test/resources/contract/ripdpi-bundle.schema.json and validated by a contract test in BOTH CIs. Prose lives in docs/RIPDPI-BUNDLE.md but this file is authoritative. All fields added after schema_version 1 are OPTIONAL and additive: an old client ignores them, a new client reads them, so schema_version stays 1 (a bump would make old clients drop the whole block). Bump schema_version only for a breaking change, and update the client parser before the server emits the new version.
$comment: Canonical source: ripdpi-vpn-deploy/contract/ripdpi-bundle.schema.json — keep the client vendored copy byte-identical. The integer below is the cross-repo drift pin: both repos assert it equals their supported schema_version.

cohort_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the resolved AWG obfuscation parameter set. Canonical preimage (UTF-8, no trailing newline): 'jc=<jc>&jmin=<jmin>&jmax=<jmax>&s1=<s1>&s2=<s2>&h1=<h1>&h2=<h2>&h3=<h3>&h4=<h4>&i1=<i1>&i2=<i2>&i3=<i3>&i4=<i4>&i5=<i5>' where each value is its base-10 (jc..h4) or lowercase-hex (i1..i5) form, and an absent i-value renders as the empty string. The client recomputes this from the parsed params and compares; a mismatch means the bundle's params drifted from the cohort the fingerprint was minted for (show 'profile outdated, refresh subscription' instead of a silent handshake stall).

private_key_placeholder.description: Always true: the per-device WireGuard private key is never stored server-side. The client substitutes its locally-held key; see docs/RIPDPI-BUNDLE.md 'Private-key recovery flow' for what the client does when no local key is present.

insecure.description: Always present and false. The client treats a missing or true value as a configuration error and refuses to connect.

salamander_upstream_tag.description: The upstream Hysteria2 release tag (e.g. 'v2.9.0') whose Salamander algorithm this server runs. The client compares it to the Salamander version its bundled obfuscator implements and warns the user on a version skew instead of failing the handshake opaquely. Sourced from hysteria.version in SOPS.

topology.description: Declares transport topology the client cannot infer from the flat outbounds list. Lets the client distinguish a split-hop or realm-relayed endpoint from a direct one and act (or at least surface it) instead of silently mis-modelling a dual-role flow.

split_hop_egress.description: True when the endpoint is the entry of a two-VPS split-hop topology (entry and egress are different hosts). The client must not assume per-IP egress identity.

hysteria_realm.description: Realm/relay identifier when the Hysteria2 endpoint is reached via a STUN/NAT-traversal realm relay rather than directly; null when direct.

schema_version.description: Contract version of the ripdpi object. Currently 1. All post-1 fields are additive and optional, so this stays 1; the client rejects (ignores) a ripdpi block whose schema_version it does not recognise.

amneziawg.description: AWG device-VPN entries. Empty array when AmneziaWG is not enabled for the cohort.

hysteria_extras.description: Map keyed by the exact Hysteria2 outbound tag emit-singbox.sh emits. Empty object when Hysteria is not enabled.

expires.description: RFC 3339 / ISO-8601 UTC instant after which the subscription token stops serving this bundle (the server returns 410). Carried inside the ripdpi object so the client can warn 'subscription expires in N days, refresh' proactively, instead of discovering expiry only when the fetch fails. Optional; absent for non-expiring tokens.
